cells.rationale: Global leader in advanced materials R&D and application across diverse high-tech industries including aerospace, automotive, defense, and energy, with extensive academic and industrial research infrastructure.

evidence: Korea Institute of Science and Technology (KIST)

Renowned for engineering and materials science, with strong integration of R&D into industrial applications across automotive, aerospace, and chemical sectors.

evidence: TNO (Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research)

evidence: CEA (French Alternative Energies and Atomic Energy Commission)
